audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was 'Skill' under 'Level 1 is yours', levels 2-3 were 'Tryndamere' under whys calling both even, levels 4-5 were 'Skill' under a why saying they favour Zac, and level 6 was 'Skill' under 'Level 6 flips to you'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Tryndamere, Skill, Skill, Zac, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere] and the whys agree row for row. The already-audited mirror agrees on rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 6; it differs on rows 2 and 5, which is recorded rather than guessed at.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 realigned in both layers with ratings, and phases[3].why rewritten to state why Zac owns 4-5.

audit.why: Zac's window is 4-5 on full blob sustain; yours are level 1, level 6 (Let's Bounce! is an engage tool, not a duel button) and the crit item after.

audit.whatIsWrong: His Q is called 'Stretching Strike' in spikes[0] and mid — the real name is Stretching Strikes. Its auto-attack reset and 800 range were missing, Elastic Slingshot had no cooldown, Unstable Matter's max-health damage never appeared, and the blob-reabsorb heal was described only as 'let him eat blobs'.
audit.why: Riot kit: Q is Stretching Strikes, 800 range, 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, flagged autoReset — his grab opens with an attack wind-up. E is 21/18/15/12/9s, so a missed engage leaves him without it for a full 21 seconds at rank 1. W is a flat 5s dealing a percentage of maximum health, so armour is the wrong answer. Cell Division sheds chunks he can reabsorb for health, which is exactly why stepping on blobs matters and why Grievous Wounds decides long trades.
audit.corrected: Fixed the Q name in both places and rewrote dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zac's E carries a 'grounding — shuts off enemy dashes' derived flag.
audit.why: Riot's text for Elastic Slingshot describes only a self-launch and says nothing about grounding enemies. The flag contradicts the description, so no line was written claiming your Spinning Slash gets shut off by it.
audit.corrected: No edit written on this point.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zac.json E text vs its grounding flag

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Elastic Slingshot's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Full blob sustain wins him the extended trades here — take short ones only. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe and hold E.

edits.before: Zac gets his full kit and passive blob sustain online here, so extended trades refill his health. Dodge his Stretching Strike (Q) and Elastic Slingshot (E) rather than facechecking; if he lands a Q-Q double grab you eat real damage. Look to punish the long cooldown on his E after he uses it to engage or roam.

edits.before: L2 through 5 even out as his passive blobs, Stretching Strike, and Elastic Slingshot come online and extended trades heal him back. Dodge his grabs rather than facechecking, and punish the 21s E cooldown after he engages. L4-5 is his best window with full sustain, so pick your fights.

edits.before: His engage. E-spin away from it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is down 21s at rank 1 — the whole window after it is yours.

edits.before: Build 100 fury on the wave, E-spin onto Zac with a crit loaded, AA-W slow, and spin out before the answer.
edits.after: His Q is an auto reset that grabs at 800 range — the wind-up is the tell, so step out before the cast lands.

edits.before: That is Zac's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Every blob he reabsorbs is health back — walk over them before he does.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Unstable Matter hits max health every 5s — armour will not save you.
